1.web: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
1.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Blessed is the man that feareth Jehovah, That delighteth greatly in his commandments.

2.web: His seed will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.
2.asv: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: The generation of the upright shall be blessed.

3.web: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
3.asv: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his righteousness endureth for ever.

4.web: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.
4.asv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: He isgracious, and merciful, and righteous.

5.web: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.
5.asv: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth; He shall maintain his cause in judgment.

6.web: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.
6.asv: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

7.web: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
7.asv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: His heart is fixed, trusting in Jehovah.

8.web: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.
8.asv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he seehis desireupon his adversaries.

9.web: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
9.asv: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever: His horn shall be exalted with honor.

10.web: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.
10.asv: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: The desire of the wicked shall perish.
